LanguageData.INSDoor_Polymer.label: Insulated Autodoor (Polymer)
LanguageData.INSDoor_Polymer.description: A polymer-insulated door that divides rooms and has an insulation-value of 80%. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down.
LanguageData.INSDoorSimple_Polymer.label: Insulated Door (Polymer)
LanguageData.INSDoorSimple_Polymer.description: A polymer-insulated door that divides rooms and has an insulation-value of 80%. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.
